title: Add a "compare with live version" option to a page's edit history.
author: UDAR-TomH
body_preview: ### Problem statement Currently, if an editor makes several draft revisions to a page before publishing, and then sends it to a moderator for review, it only allows you to make comparisons to the previously saved version. This makes it difficult for a moderator to view all of the changes made at one time, as they can only view the incremental changes between each draft.
